title: 第三章 五城兵马司第四章 小小奖励拿捏
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 神枢营乃京营三大营之一，乃拱卫京师的重要防卫力量。
共设提督、坐营官、大号头官及监枪号头官、中军官、千总、选锋把总、把总等职。
张宏领着贾环来到京都郊外，神枢据地。
初入殿院，便可瞧见几个教练把总，正顶着烈日，操练上百京兵。
“张把总，我也得和他们一样操练吗？”
贾环想了想，便顺口问了一句。
张宏也是个人精，自是听了贾环的弦外之音。
不过想想也是，这三爷乃贾府出身，纵然是个庶子，在府邸也不受宠爱，可瘦死的骆驼比马大，到底不像他们，穷苦出身，吃得了苦。
“那倒犯不着。”
张宏边走边说，“孙总旗是我一手带出来的，他在他底下当个小旗，正好负责小花枝巷那一片地。”
小花枝巷！
那不是京都最繁华的一条街吗？
说什么青楼酒馆，就跟扎窝似的往里凑，还常有醉汉闹事，但里头实打实的油水，明眼人都清楚！
贾环挑了挑眉，心道这银子是真没白花。
一个时辰后。
贾环腰佩旗令，身着大红对襟鸳鸯战袍，头戴军帽，脚踩皮靴，威风凛凛。
“啧啧，不愧是张把总送来的人，一看就非池中物，定能管辖好花巷一带。”
孙总旗孙阳呵呵笑着，谄媚之色尽浮表面。
开玩笑，这厮和自己的顶头上司，张宏关系匪浅也就罢了，还背靠荣国府，与京营节度使王子腾还沾亲带故！
这般人物，他一个小小总旗，哪还敢轻易怠慢？
“孙总旗谬赞。”
贾环抱拳，目光灼灼，“如今我已入神枢营，不知何时可以登记巡逻？”
“巡逻啊……”
孙阳捻了捻胡须，心思飞转。
想着贾环初入京营，又是走的后门，只怕这巡逻拱卫一事还一窍不通。
未免生出祸端，他便朝一个心腹招了招手，低声道：“你去将周旭，马癞，霍老三他们喊来。”
心腹得令，即刻下去通传。
不大一会儿，便见一个雄赳赳的汉子踏步而来。
而跟在他后头的两个兵卒，一个顶着癞子头，年纪瞧着和贾环差不多大。
另一个年纪颇长，满脸精明相，一看就是个老滑头。
率先进门的汉子拱了拱手，态度恭敬道：“卑职周旭，参见总旗大人！”
“卑职马癞，参见总旗大人！”
“卑职霍老三，参见总旗大人！”
孙阳颔首示意，淡淡笑道：“打今儿起，你们就在贾小旗手底下当差，负责花巷一带。”
周旭略默，心里头说不上是个什么滋味。
想他入京营五年，勤勤恳恳，好不容易盼到小旗之位有了空缺，且在同营之中，无一人能比他更担得上这个差事……
却不料，造化弄人。
期待半月的升迁之路，竟被一个纨绔拦腰截断！
content_en:
Shenshu Camp is one of the three major battalions of the Beijing Camp and an important defensive force to defend the capital.
There are a total of admiral, camp officer, large chief officer, gun chief officer, middle officer, thousand commander, front selector commander, general commander and other positions.
Zhang Hong led Jia Huan to the outskirts of Kyoto, where Shenshu was based.
When you first enter the palace, you can see several coaches and generals training hundreds of soldiers under the scorching sun.
"Boss Zhang, do I have to train like them?"
Jia Huan thought for a while and asked casually.
Zhang Hong is also a good person, so he naturally listened to Jia Huan's implication.
But think about it, this third master was born in the Jia family. Even though he was a bastard, he was not favored in the palace, but the skinny camel was bigger than the horse. After all, unlike them, he was born in poverty and suffered hardships.
"That's not a crime."
Zhang Hong said as he walked, "I brought Mr. Sun out single-handedly. He is a small flag under him, and he happens to be in charge of the area of ​​Xiaohuazhi Lane."
Xiaohuazhi Lane!
Isn't that the busiest street in Kyoto?
Speaking of brothels and taverns, they are crowded together like a den, and drunkards often make trouble, but the real money and money inside is obvious to anyone with a discerning eye!
Jia Huan raised his eyebrows, thinking that the money was really not wasted.
…
An hour later.
Jia Huan wears a flag order around his waist, wears a bright red double-breasted mandarin duck war robe, a military cap on his head, and leather boots on his feet, looking majestic.
"Tsk, tsk, he is indeed the person Mr. Zhang sent here. He looks like a man in the pond at first glance. He will definitely be able to take charge of the Huaxiang area."
Sun Zongqi, Sun Yang, chuckled, with a flattering look on his face.
Just kidding, this guy only has a close relationship with his immediate boss, Zhang Hong. He also has the backing of Rongguo Mansion and is related to Prince Teng, the military governor of Beijing Camp!
How could such a person dare to neglect him so easily even though he is a small general?
"Mr. Sun Qi is so complimentary."
Jia clasped his fists, his eyes blazing, "Now that I have entered Shenshu Camp, when can I register for patrol?"
"Patrol..."
Sun Yang twirled his beard, his mind racing.
Thinking that Jia Huan first entered the capital camp and used the back door, he was afraid that he still didn't know anything about patrolling the guards.
To avoid causing trouble, he waved to a confidant and whispered: "Go and call Zhou Xu, Ma Lei, and Huo Laosan."
"Yes!"
When the confidant receives the order, he immediately goes down and passes it on.
After a while, I saw a majestic man approaching.
The two soldiers following him, one with a leprosy head, looked to be about the same age as Jia Huan.
The other one is quite old, with a shrewd look on his face, and he looks like a cunning old man at first glance.
The man who took the lead in the door bowed his hands and said respectfully: "I have a humble position, Zhou Xu, please see the General Banner Master!"
"Ma Lei, a man of humble rank, please see the Lord of the General Banner!"
"Huo Laosan, a humble official, please see the general banner master!"
Sun Yang nodded and said with a faint smile: "From now on, you will work under Jia Xiaoqi and be responsible for the Huaxiang area."
Zhou Xu was silent for a moment, unable to explain how he felt.
I think he has been in the Beijing camp for five years and worked hard to finally find a vacancy in the position of Xiaoqi, and no one in the same camp can take on this job better than him...
But unexpectedly, fate plays a trick on people.
The road to promotion that I had been looking forward to for half a month was cut off by a dude!
"yes."
